title: Aggregate Orders by Weekday vs Weekend
description: Classify each order as placed on a **Weekend** (Saturday or Sunday) or **Weekday** (Monday–Friday) using `EXTRACT(ISODOW ...)`. Then aggregate the **total order count** and **total revenue** for each day type.
solution_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM order_date) IN (6, 7) THEN 'Weekend' ELSE 'Weekday' END AS day_type, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(amount) AS total_revenue FROM orders GROUP BY CASE WHEN EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM order_date) IN (6, 7) THEN 'Weekend' ELSE 'Weekday' END ORDER BY day_type

test_cases.description: Jan 10=Sat, Jan 11=Sun are weekends (2 orders). All other 10 orders are weekdays.

hints: EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM order_date) returns ISO day of week: 1=Monday through 7=Sunday — so 6=Saturday and 7=Sunday are the weekend values.
Use a CASE expression in both SELECT and GROUP BY to classify each order, then COUNT and SUM within each group.
explanation: ISODOW (ISO Day Of Week) returns 1 for Monday through 7 for Sunday. Jan 10, 2026=Saturday(6) and Jan 11=Sunday(7) are weekends. The remaining 10 dates (Jan 5 Mon through Jan 9 Fri, Jan 12 Mon through Jan 16 Fri) are weekdays. Weekend orders=2, revenue=180+220=400. Weekday orders=10, revenue=all others.
